decisions.reason: This low-cost burner component extends the established radiant heater business, so keeping it costs little while its value is still uncertain.
This flagship electric infrared panel line has its own page and fits the electrification direction, so the uncertain upside is well worth its modest carrying cost.
The halogen heater has a dedicated page and sits in the growing electric segment, and it costs little to keep while demand is still unresolved.
This multi-model industrial electric hall heater line is close to the core business and serves large-hall customers, so the option stays valuable.
The hydrogen-ready flagship series is in real-world operation and central to the low-carbon strategy, with high remaining upside uncertainty, so it is a clear keep.
